name: Minnesota Vikings
status: Phase B job d6 (2026-09-23). Sort: REDESIGNED (2013 set: plain numbers in the Vikings font, VIKINGS under the collar, cuff stripes, new pants stripes; 2013 Norseman). Colours sourced; kit albedo INFERRED. Numbers: modern rounded base family from club Skol outlines, with the first-digit positional horn explicitly left for coordinator integration. Helmet horn: the retail horn kept (unchanged in shape since 2006), shell recoloured; facemask grey from 2026 photos (the Wikipedia diagram shows black). u1 font refinement (2026-10-05): modern base digit contours authored for torso and visible shoulders; helmet/name artwork unchanged.

sources.kit_rules: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Minnesota_Vikings&action=raw (Logo and uniforms: 2013 set; purple pants with the road jersey; 2026 Rivalries and Winter Warrior are alternates)
sources.colours: data/nfl2k5_scorebug_sprite/team_colors_official_2026.json (MIN: Purple #4F2683, Gold #FFC62F, White; 2026 NFL Record and Fact Book p.190)
sources.stadium_photos: https://www.vikings.com/photos/packers-game-action-week-1-2026 (U.S. Bank Stadium: purple end zones, white lettering; the Vikings wore the throwback set that day)
sources.number_font: Ten Skol-Regular base numeral outlines extracted from the official 2025 Vikings media guide (subset xref740); rounded base family checked against current official Nike Jefferson18 jersey and dated 2026 game photographs. These base contours do not include the first-digit-only curved horn; native shared texture sampling cannot safely express that positional form without coordinator work. Skol is not claimed to be an exact complete jersey font.

number_art.positional_limit: The same standalone digit TXTR is selected for tens and units by 0x8E910; both NUMBER_L/R sample the base ink interval, so a right-side horn cannot be limited to the first digit by safe texture-only art.
